## Finland’s Verda raises $189m to expand its GPU platform and services

- October 15, 2026
- Analyst: Sacha Kavanagh

Finland-based Verda raised $189m in an oversubscribed Series B round led by Emergence Capital, as well as additional investment.

results.title: Helsinki’s newest AI unicorn on building the full stack
highlights:
I am Tom Turula. This newsletter was born out of a passion for the Nordic AI ecosystem, its growing momentum, and the challenges and opportunities that come with it. Verda is a case in point. The Helsinki-based company in September announced new funding at a unicorn valuation, outlined plans for a future IPO, and is scaling at an incredible pace.

...

Verda is sometimes described as one of the few vertically integrated AI infrastructure companies in Europe. The company operates and rents out data centre infrastructure, specialises in fine-tuning workload optimisation, and helps customers connect to, select and tailor compute through easy interfaces.

Arturs Polis, Verda’s CTO, joined Datacrunch, as the company was then known, in 2022 from a machine learning PhD program. This was before ChatGPT, but advanced image generation and early LLMs already offered a taste of what was to come.

...

“We were one of the early companies in Europe – and the world – catering to this market.”

...

Over its lifetime, Verda has raised more than €390 million in debt and equity to fund its expansion. But according to Arturs Polis, the company’s early frugality has helped it scale as demand exploded.

“Being bootstrapped made us resilient in addressing market needs effectively, and as we scale, it gives us an extra boost. Our expectations are extremely optimistic, and all the indicators show that growth will be extremely fast”, he tells me.

📊 Hockey-stick growth. In June, Verda announced that its revenue run rate had reached $100 million, a tenfold increase over the previous 18 months. Since then, it has climbed to around $165 million, placing the company among the fastest-growing AI businesses in the Nordics. In conjunction with a $189 million funding round in September Verda reached unicorn valuation at more than 1 billion USD.

...

> “Within 20 minutes, you can add more than 100 GPUs for training your model without talking to sales.”

...

Arturs Polis: “Maybe people don’t immediately realise that we are vertically integrated. We have an intimate understanding of the hardware we run on: GPU accelerators, storage and networking. We build multiple layers on top of that to control and orchestrate that infrastructure, all the way to running models and generating tokens efficiently. So we really operate in all those layers, and we’re now taking larger and larger steps in data centers as well.

Our goal is to be the lowest-emitting large-scale AI cloud company. To do that, you need scale and efficiency. Those are the keys to being sustainable, and we want to set an example for other companies that it can be done, and be a voice in this space. Verda is Esperanto for green, and the aim is to live up to those values, but at scale.”

...

A useful industry term is ‘goodput’: the fraction of installed infrastructure that’s doing useful work – either how well each GPU is utilised or whether the servers in a cluster participate in training or inference. With so many components, it boils down to handling special cases and faults so that recovery from errors is fast.

“We can tune our platform to the needs of top researchers in the field.”

On pricing, our efficiency translates to our customers, along with ease of use. We were one of the first in the market to offer instant clusters: a multi-node, high-performance computing platform that can be procured from our cloud console, either through the API or with a few clicks. Within 20 minutes, you can add more than 100 GPUs for training your model without talking to sales or going through multiple contract stages. We’ve always prided ourselves on our on-demand compute.

Increasingly, I hear from users who have agents create and destroy virtual machine instances in our cloud, using our API or MCP [model context protocol]. This is already happening, and we expect it to accelerate.”

# Fińska Verda wyceniana ponad miliard dolarów. Pozyskała 164,8 mln euro na rozwój chmury AI 

 Dodane: 23.09.2026 

 

 Firma dostarcza pełnoskalową infrastrukturę chmurową dedykowaną sztucznej inteligencji, opierając swoje centra danych w Finlandii na w 100% odnawialnych źródłach energii.

## Przełomowa runda serii B i nowi inwestorzy

Nowe pozyskane środki to efekt nadsubskrybowanej rundy serii B, której przewodniczył fundusz Emergence Capital. W finansowaniu wzięła udział szeroka grupa inwestorów instytucjonalnych oraz strategicznych: MUFG Innovation Partners, Supermicro, Varma Mutual Pension Insurance Company, Lifeline Ventures, 6 Degrees Capital (6DC), byFounders oraz Tesi (Finnish Industry Investment Ltd).

W rundzie uczestniczyli również inwestorzy anielscy: Ola Tørudbakken (Meta) oraz Mark Saroufim (Core Auto, GPUMODE). Wraz z najnowszym zasileniem kapitałowym łączna kwota pozyskanego przez spółkę finansowania przekroczyła 392,3 mln euro (450 mln dolarów).

...

Założona w 2020 roku przez Rubena Bryona spółka Verda zarządza pełnym stosami technologicznym infrastruktury AI. Działalność podmiotu obejmuje zarówna fizyczne centra danych i sprzęt, jak i platformę chmurową oraz badania nad sztuczną inteligencją.

Kluczowym wyróżnikiem startupu jest wykorzystanie przewag naturalnych regionu nordyckiego. Centra danych firmy zlokalizowane w Finlandii korzystają w 100% z odnawialnych źródeł energii oraz efektywnego chłodzenia naturalnego, co pozwala ograniczać ślad węglowy procesów obliczeniowych.

W listopadzie ubiegłego roku spółka przeprowadziła rebranding z nazwy DataCrunch na Verda. Nazwa odnosi się do hiszpańskiego słowa oznaczającego „prawdopodobny/prawdziwy” oraz słowa „zielony” w języku esperanto, co według przedstawicieli firmy ma odzwierciedlać wartości technologicznej integralności i zrównoważonej innowacji.

...

## Dynamiczny wzrost przychodów i globalna ekspansja

Runda finansowania nastąpiła po osiągnięciu przez Verdę w lipcu rocznego tempa przychodów (ARR) na poziomie 143,85 mln euro (165 mln dolarów). Spółka zabezpieczyła także pożyczkę w wysokości 22 mln euro od Nordic Investment Bank (NIB). Wcześniej, w kwietniu bieżącego roku, firma pozyskała niemal 102 mln euro w rundzie prowadzonej przez Lifeline Ventures, a we wrześniu ubiegłego roku zebrała 55 mln euro w serii A.

Joe Floyd, General Partner w Emergence Capital, zwraca uwagę na rosnącą lukę między popytem a podażą mocy obliczeniowych dla AI. Zauważa, że Verda sprawnie zabezpiecza i skaluje swoje zasoby, posiadając technologię oraz ambicję niezbędną do stania się kluczowym dostawcą infrastruktury.

Pozyskany kapitał zostanie przeznaczony na przyspieszenie rozwoju produktów we wszystkich warstwach chmury AI, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem usług inferencji oraz zwiększania mocy obliczeniowych w erze rozwiązań agentowych. Firma niedawno otworzyła biura w Londynie oraz San Francisco, a w planach ma dalszą ekspansję na rynki europejskie, amerykańskie i azjatyckie. Obecnie Verda zatrudnia około 250 osób reprezentujących ponad 40 narodowości.

results.title: Verda官网：功能、价格与竞品对比 - AiTest123
highlights:
# Verda

面向 AI 训练与推理的高性能 GPU 云平台，支持按需弹性扩缩容。

官网地址 https://verda.com/

 依据官网内容整理 最后核验于 2026-10-11，数据来源见页脚。 

价格 GPU 按需 $0.2060/h 起，预留最长 2 年享 25% 折扣

复核 2026-10-11

## Verda编辑总结

Verda 是面向 AI 领域的 GPU 云服务平台，提供从 GB300、B300、B200、H200、H100、A100 到 RTX PRO 6000、L40S 等 NVIDIA GPU 实例，以及 CPU 实例、即时集群和 Serverless 容器。官网公开了完整按需价格表，例如 1x H100 SXM5 80GB 为 $3.93/h、Spot 价 $1.96/h，1x A100 SXM4 40GB 为 $1.37/h，按需付费不锁定长约。短板是官网未公开免费试用额度与最低起租门槛，且价格以美元计费，国内用户需自行评估网络与结算条件。

...

Verda 是面向 AI 领域的 GPU 云服务平台，为需要跑训练、微调和推理的用户提供按需租用的算力资源。

包括的实例涵盖 GB300 SXM6 288GB、B300 SXM6 268GB、B200 SXM6 180GB、H200 SXM5 141GB、H100 SXM5 80GB、A100 SXM4 80GB、Tesla V100 16GB、RTX PRO 6000 96GB、L40S 48GB 等多代 NVIDIA 硬件，同时提供 CPU-TURIN 系列和 CPU 系列实例，并支持 1x、2x、4x、8x 多卡配置与 NVLink 机型。除单机实例外，还有带 InfiniBand 互联、最多 144 张 GPU 的即时集群，以及自动扩缩容的 Serverless 容器。

普通开发者可以按需启动单卡实例做实验；团队可用即时集群跑多节点训练；生产用户可走 Serverless 容器或直接调 API 管理资源。官方结算方式分按需付费与预留折扣两档。

...

### 多代 GPU 实例

覆盖 GB300、B300、B200、H200、H100、A100、V100、RTX PRO 6000、L40S 等机型，可按 1x、2x、4x、8x 配置，NVLink 机型可用。

### 按需与 Spot 计费

按需实例随开随停，不锁长约；同机型另有 Spot 价，如 1x H100 SXM5 80GB 从 $3.93/h 降至 $1.96/h。

### 预留折扣

自助部署可选 1 个月 2%、3 个月 3%、6 个月 4%、1 年 8%、2 年 25% 的按需价格折扣，也能申请定制报价。

### 即时集群

多节点集群带 InfiniBand 互联，最多 144 张 GPU，自助开通，支持用 UI 控制台、Terraform、SDK 或 API 管理。

...

## Verda值不值得用？

Verda 的定位很明确：给需要 GPU 又不愿一次性投入硬件的 AI 团队提供弹性算力。当你要跑短周期实验、需要最新一代 NVIDIA 卡（GB300、B300、B200），或流量波峰明显、想按小时计费时，它比自建机房更划算。当你的任务长期稳定、追求极致单价时，预留 2 年 25% 折扣仍不如自购或长约；若业务场景对国内网络延迟敏感，公开信息也未说明有无区域节点可选。

...

入门先把路子走对

1. 先看按需价目表在 pricing 页按机型查 CP、RAM、VRAM 和价格，先确定目标卡型每小时成本，再决定实例规格。
2. 用 Spot 价试水能容忍中断的实验优先开 Spot，同机型价格通常是按需价的一半左右，如 H100 从 $3.93/h 降到 $1.96/h。
3. 登录后再部署控制台部署入口需要登录，先用 Sign up 建账号，再进 UI 控制台或 SDK 提交实例申请。

进阶省时间也省钱

1. 长任务走预留确定要用半年以上就把自助部署改成预留，6 个月省 4%、1 年省 8%、2 年省 25%，折扣直接作用在按需价上。
2. 多机训练选即时集群多节点训练直接用即时集群，带 InfiniBand 互联，最多 144 张 GPU，比逐台开实例再手工组网省事。
3. 基础设施代码化把集群配置写进 Terraform 或用 SDK 调用，能避免手工开实例留下的资源忘记关、账单失控问题。
4. 大集群走定制报价超过 144 张 GPU 的自助上限或需要特殊配置时，走 custom quote 通道比在自助页拼实例更灵活。

...

### 预算有限的个人开发者

有条件

按需最低也要约 $0.2060/h，试错前需要先估算总花费。

### 国内网络敏感型业务

官网未说明是否提供国内节点、以及国内访问的延迟表现，对国内用户延迟敏感的业务要先自行验证。

## Verda优点和缺点

### 优点

- H100 按需 $3.93/h、Spot $1.96/h，价格在官网直接列出
- 覆盖 GB300、B300、B200 到 A100 等多代 NVIDIA 卡
- 按需付费不锁长约，可随时启停部署
- 预留最长 2 年享 25% 折扣，降低长期成本
- 即时集群最多 144 张 GPU，带 InfiniBand 互联
- 支持 UI 控制台、Terraform、SDK、API 多种管理方式

### 缺点

- 价格以美元计费，人民币结算方式未说明
- 高配机型如 GB300 按需 $10.74/h，成本门槛高

## Verda版本与计费对比

| 方案 | 价格 | 包含内容 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1x H100 SXM5 80GB | $3.93/h，Spot $1.96/h | 30 CPU / 120 GB RAM / 80 GB VRAM | NVLink 可选 |
| 1x A100 SXM4 40GB | $1.37/h，Spot $0.6865/h | 22 CPU / 120 GB RAM / 40 GB VRAM | 入门级 AI 训练卡 |
| 1x Tesla V100 16GB | $0.2060/h，Spot $0.1030/h | 6 CPU / 23 GB RAM / 16 GB VRAM | 最便宜的 GPU 档 |
| 预留折扣 | 按需价 2%~25% off | 1 个月 / 3 个月 / 6 个月 / 1 年 / 2 年 | 可另申请定制报价 |

以上为公开费率整理，厂商保留调价权利，实际以官方页面为准。

...

| 指标 | 数值 | 数据来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 月推理请求量 | +300M | Magnific 客户案例 |
| 目标推理延迟 | ~2s | Magnific 客户案例 |
| 弹性扩容 GPU 数量 | +500 GPUs | Magnific 客户案例，从零扩容 |
| B 轮融资 | $189M | Series B |
| 即时集群最大 GPU 数 | 144x GPUs | Instant clusters |

## Verda常见问题

Verda 的 GPU 怎么收费？＋

按小时计费，机型不同价格不同。1x H100 SXM5 80GB 是 $3.93/h、Spot $1.96/h；1x A100 SXM4 40GB 是 $1.37/h、Spot $0.6865/h；入门级的 1x Tesla V100 16GB 是 $0.2060/h、Spot $0.1030/h。所有价格在官网 pricing 页按硬件、CPU 核数、内存、显存逐项列出。

可以只按小时用、不签长约吗？＋

可以。按需实例采用 pay-as-you-go 计费，随时开始和结束部署，没有长期承诺。如果确定要长期使用，也可以选预留方案，1 个月省 2%、3 个月省 3%、6 个月省 4%、1 年省 8%、2 年省 25%，都是按需价基础上的折扣。

...

## 数据来源与说明

本页由 AiTest 编辑组 整理，最后复核于 2026-10-11。价格、模型名与功能可能随官方调整而变化，请以官方页面为准；本站与所列工具无隶属关系。

results.title: How Epsilon Health accelerates radiology AI training with Verda
highlights:
Dedicated capacity. Epsilon Health needed a dedicated NVIDIA HGX™ B300 GPU cluster to scale its compute for the next generation of its models. There was no availability, it was hard to find long-term contracts at reasonable prices, and shared platforms had no capacity either. 

 A small team, without room to build ML infrastructure from scratch. As a small team, Epsilon Health couldn't dedicate significant human resources to building and maintaining its own ML infrastructure. Whatever partner they chose had to take that work off their plate, not add to it.

...

## Solution 

 Epsilon Health partnered with Verda to implement a dedicated instant cluster on Verda’s platform, with NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra (B300) GPUs, chosen specifically for what the hardware generation unlocks, not just for raw compute. 

 Managed infrastructure, hands-off cluster ops. Managed Kubernetes and direct support from Verda's engineering team, including custom scheduling, automated hardware health checks, and help designing a dataset-caching approach, let Epsilon's team focus on model training rather than infrastructure management. 

 High-HBM capacity for native-resolution training. NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra's memory capacity lets Epsilon Health train on X-ray, CT, and MRI data at native resolution instead of downscaling, supporting the large context windows volumetric imaging requires and improving fine-grained detection of faint findings. 

 Blackwell-tuned kernels for training speed. Flash Attention 4 and other libraries built specifically for NVIDIA Blackwell hardware gave Epsilon Health meaningful speedups over an equivalent number of NVIDIA Hopper architecture nodes. 

 Multi-node training at scale. Training runs span multiple nodes at a time, using NVLink and InfiniBand for fast parameter sharding and weight updates across the cluster. 

 Fast availability, on workable terms. Verda provided capacity quickly, at a reasonable price and term length, at a point when dedicated NVIDIA HGX B300 capacity was difficult to find anywhere on the market.

...

Epsilon Health's ability to keep improving its models depends on how fast it can train and how many ideas it can test in a given week. Verda's infrastructure changed both. 

 Less infrastructure work, more experiments. Managed cluster operations and Kubernetes scheduling freed up engineering time Epsilon's team previously spent on infrastructure, letting them run roughly 5x more experiments per week. 

 Faster training, shorter iteration loops. Upgraded hardware and Blackwell-tuned libraries cut training time significantly against Epsilon's previous Hopper-based setup, training jobs roughly 3x faster. 

 A shorter path from a research idea to a better-read scan. Faster training loops mean more research directions get tested sooner, feeding directly into the loop that makes Epsilon’s models and radiologists more accurate.

results.title: Finnish AI Infrastructure Startup Verda Secures €100 Million in Series C+ Funding - EU Startups News
results.author: Lars Eriksson
highlights:
Verda, a Helsinki-based artificial intelligence infrastructure company, has raised €100 million (approximately $108 million) in a Series C+ funding round completed in April 2026. The financing marks a significant milestone for the Finnish startup as it accelerates its push into Europe’s competitive AI cloud infrastructure market.

The capital injection will primarily support two strategic objectives for Verda. The company plans to substantially scale its high-performance AI cloud infrastructure platform while simultaneously expanding its team. The startup intends to recruit 100 new employees by the end of 2026, underscoring its ambitions to strengthen its technical and commercial capabilities across product development, engineering, and go-to-market operations.
